maya (AE): Heads-up: Prospect Meridian wants a perf POC: target 600 RPS sustained chat, median payload 7 tokens, SLA ask p95 < 220ms. They also want a short cost sensitivity for reserved vs burst. Can we run next Tues?
arjun (SE): Yep. Recommend running two configs: redwood-13b-quant and redwood-open-7b fallback. Plan: 45m steady-state run (poisson), then 10m spike + 5m cooldown. Include warmup 15m.
fiona (SRE): Confirming region: eu-west1 required. We need to validate KMS latency (customer-managed). Also note we should enable request-level tracing.
noah (Sales Ops): I'll model pricing after we get tokens/sec sample. If 7 tokens/req @600 RPS => 4200 tokens/sec baseline. I'll produce reserved vs burst monthly estimates and a break-even table.
arjun (SE): Load generator snippet:
```
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \
  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 600 --duration 45m \
  --arrival poisson --pfx-cache warm --warmup 15m --prompts meridian_prompts.json

# spike
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen --qps 900 --duration 10m --ramp 20s --arrival poisson
```
ci-bot: scheduled run 2026-04-07T08:30Z, results at https://ci.internal/redwood/meridian/4322109999/results.json
maya (AE): Action items: Arjun = runbook + heatmap, Noah = pricing lines, Fiona = security checklist. Arjun please include p50/p95/p99/p999 + batch hist + kv hit rate in writeup.
arjun (SE): Will do. Plan to post a 1-page summary for prospect and raw results link.
fiona (SRE): I'll verify KMS path. If client-managed KMS adds >7ms median, document and propose cached-key approach. Also check multi-AZ failover latency.
maya (AE): Thanks team. Keep thread updated. :rocket:
